builds.notes: Disc/Meditation first, respec Shadow at 40 (respec 1g, rising). Order: 2 Wand Spec, 5 Spirit Tap, 5 Twin Disciplines, 3 Mental Strength, 3 Meditation
Optional respec at 35 to go deep Discipline for Penance, keeping 5 Spirit Tap; Twilight Focus if solo / Silent Resolve in groups

rotations.shadow: Buffs (Fortitude, Inner Fire) > PW:Shield > Mind Blast > SW:Pain > Devouring Plague* > Mind Flay* (*mana allowing) > wand. Before Mind Flay open with Smite. AoE = multi-dot SW:Pain.
holy: Fort + Inner Fire > PW:S > Holy Fire > Smite > Mind Blast > SW:P > wand; AoE: Holy Nova on Searing Light procs
disc_heal: PW:S as needed > Penance (first tick instant) > Heal > Renew
rotations.mana: Five-second rule; out-of-casting regen = Spirit/4 + 12.5 per 2s (Wowhead). Wands do not scale with spell damage (Sep 24 dev notes).
